=== ELM Specification Summary (from ELM_Specifications_Bundlev1.4) ===
Module: Employee Leave Management (ELM)
Module code in registry: leave_elm (package: modules.leave, base_path: /leave)
Supported Leave Categories (CFR-EL-002 / BR-EL-001):
- CL (Casual Leave): 8 days/year, supports full-day, first-half, second-half (0.5 day), lapses at year-end.
- RH (Restricted Holiday): 2 days/year, requires holiday calendar applicability, lapses at year-end.
- SCL (Special Casual Leave): up to 15 days/year for admissible special purpose, lapses at year-end.
- EL (Earned Leave): 30 days/year for non-faculty, carries forward.
- VL (Vacation Leave): 60 days/year for faculty during academic vacation periods; unused VL converts 2 VL : 1 EL at year-end.
- COL (Commuted Leave): 20 days/year medical/balance-controlled, carries forward.
Station Leave (BR-EL-013): Captured inside the same leave application (is_station_leave, station_leave_address) rather than as a separate request.
Roles & Permissions (CFR-EL-001, BR-EL-036, role-assignment-guide.md):
- Permissions:
  - ("leave_elm.application.view", "See leave applications")
  - ("leave_elm.application.apply", "Submit a leave application")
  - ("leave_elm.application.approve", "Approve or reject a leave application")
- Role grants (ROLE_GRANTS):
  - "faculty": ["leave_elm.application.view", "leave_elm.application.apply"]
  - "staff": ["leave_elm.application.view", "leave_elm.application.apply"]
  - "Employee": ["leave_elm.application.view", "leave_elm.application.apply"]
  - "Leave Approver": ["leave_elm.application.view", "leave_elm.application.approve"]
  - "HOD": ["leave_elm.application.view", "leave_elm.application.approve"]

1. `core.db.mixins`:
   - `TimeStampedModel(models.Model)` provides `created_at`, `updated_at`

2. `fusion_auth.permissions`:
   - `HasModuleGrant("leave_elm")` and `HasPermission("leave_elm.application.view")`
   - `request.principal` has `.user_id`, `.username`, `.permissions`, `.active_role`
3. `modules/leave/registry.py`:
   - Defines `MODULE`, `NAV_ITEMS`, `PERMISSIONS`, `ROLE_GRANTS`
   - `MODULE = {"code": "leave_elm", "label": "Leave Management", "icon": "FaCalendarCheck", "base_path": "/leave", "nav_section": "HR & Leave", "sort_order": 20, "status": "active"}`
4. Frontend (`client/src/modules/leave/`):

   - Mantine UI (`@mantine/core`) components (`Container`, `Title`, `Card`, `Button`, `Select`, `TextInput`, `Textarea`, `Badge`, `Group`, `Stack`, `Checkbox`)
   - `routes.tsx` exports `export const routes: RouteObject[] = [...]` with relative paths matching `NAV_ITEMS` in `registry.py`.
